contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN [NOBC] ; R/ [GLOR]IA EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate with twin fillet cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN [NOBC]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them, standard is vexillum with inverted U device. Reverse inscription: [GLOR]IA EXERC ITVS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified…
